items.title: 山田涼介、池田エライザらがグッチ青山に集結 GucciCoreローンチイベント
items.summary: Gucci Aoyama hosted the launch event for Demna's 2027 Cruise collection 'GucciCore' on Nov 16, 2026. Gucci 'Friend of the House' Ryosuke Yamada attended with Eliza Ikeda, INI's Nishi Kohito, NiziU's Rima and other J-pop/entertainment figures, wearing horsebit-detailed denim and a bomber jacket. Commentary videos were cross-posted on Harper's Bazaar, WWD Japan, ELLE Japan and Esquire Japan's official Instagram accounts. No public engagement counts shown on the article itself.

items.title: 山田涼介、池田エライザ、本田響矢らが来場 グッチ「GucciCore」ローンチイベント
items.summary: Syndicated coverage of the same Gucci Aoyama GucciCore launch event (Nov 16, 2026), naming additional attendees including Kyoya Honda and Ryui Miyase, with snapshot photos of outfits built around Demna's horsebit denim and bomber-jacket styling.

items.title: 구찌 가방 95만원 내렸다...콧대 높던 명품업계에 무슨 일이
items.summary: Gucci cut the Mercato small tote in Korea from 4.45M to 3.5M won (-21.3%), its first markdown in over a decade; Boucheron and Van Cleef & Arpels followed with smaller cuts. Frames this as the biggest luxury markdown wave in Korea since Chanel's 2015 cuts, driven by shrinking middle-class luxury demand as the global luxury consumer base fell from ~400M to ~340M.

items.title: グッチ、異例の値下げで高級ブランド界の掟を破る ルイ・ヴィトンは追随するか
items.summary: Gucci's Padlock top-handle bag fell from EUR3,500 to EUR2,450 (-30%) in France; sneakers from EUR800 to EUR560-595. Kering frames the move as 'price system reinitialization.' CEO Luca de Meo said testing showed consumers could no longer absorb further hikes and that past increases are 'no longer sustainable.' Q3 Gucci sales fell 6% YoY to EUR1.29bn (retail -9%), hurt by weaker China/Japan traffic; conversion and average ticket improved. Raises open question of whether LV follows.

items.title: Why discounts, store closures may not be enough for Gucci as China's luxury slowdown bites
items.summary: Critical analysis arguing Gucci's price cuts and store closures (including a Jinan MixC location shut in late October after 2.5 years) may not reverse the brand's China slide. Kering CFO Armelle Poulou is quoted saying mainland China remains the 'major headwind' as consumer confidence stays subdued and shoppers grow more selective; Kering targets roughly 130 net store closures in China by 2030 under new CEO Luca de Meo's efficiency push.

items.title: Kering Group Q3 Earnings 2026: Revenues Flat as Gucci Misses
items.summary: Kering Q3 2026 revenue flat at EUR3.345bn; Gucci down 6% comparable to EUR1.291bn, still the weak link while Saint Laurent, Bottega Veneta, Jewelry (+11%) and Eyewear (+4%) grew. Traffic remained the main constraint for Gucci though conversion, average price and ticket size improved as new Demna-era collections rolled out. Included as context anchor; still within the 14-day freshness window and directly informs NEA investor-facing sentiment this week.

items.title: 대충 찍어도 명품 화보... 박보검, 남다른 피지컬과 세련된 비주얼로 '심쿵'
items.summary: Covers Park Bo-gum's new Gucci ambassador photo set released following his Nov 5 appointment as Gucci's global brand ambassador under Demna. Describes strong fan/online reaction praising his look, part of the 'A NEW CHAPTER WITH PARK BO GUM' campaign rollout.

items.title: 박보검, 증명사진인 줄...감탄 나오는 비주얼
items.summary: Reports on Park Bo-gum's Instagram post captioned 'MY NAME IS #PARKBOGUM' featuring Gucci-era photos; fan comments quoted include '힐링이다' (it's healing) and '어떻게 저렇게 완벽하지' (how is he so perfect), illustrating organic fan engagement with the new ambassador tie-up rather than paid media.

items.title: 古驰最近有什么大新闻？Demna首秀、降价40%、关店105家，3个维度说清+FAQ
items.summary: Chinese Weibo explainer-style post summarizing three Gucci storylines circulating among Chinese consumers: Demna's debut collection, price cuts of up to 40% on some items, and roughly 105 global store closures. Content reads as an SEO/FAQ-farm format repeated across many similarly-titled posts, suggesting algorithmic content amplification rather than organic individual commentary; included as a volume signal but flagged for likely low originality per bot-filter guidance.

items.title: 董思成2026年11月22日京东直播是品牌商务活动吗？
items.summary: Weibo post discussing actress/influencer Dong Siyi's Nov 22 JD.com livestream promoting the Gucci Beauty holiday series, questioning whether the appearance is a paid brand commercial activity. Reflects ongoing commercial activation rather than grassroots sentiment, but shows active Gucci Beauty e-commerce push on Chinese social platforms.

items.title: 激烈的对立——GUCCI2026秋冬秀场解读
items.summary: Zhihu long-form essay analyzing the 'sharp contrast/conflict' aesthetic of Demna's Gucci 2026 fall/winter show, discussing how it departs from predecessor Sabato De Sarno's minimalism. Represents the more analytical/critical creator-class discourse on Chinese platforms; several comments debate whether the direction will resonate with core Chinese Gucci clientele. Slightly older than ideal window but still the most substantive Zhihu discussion thread found and actively receiving comments into November.

items.title: [취재썰] '12만원 구찌 가방' 들고 명품 수선집 가보니
items.summary: Korean community (theqoo) repost of a media investigative piece where a reporter brought a cheap counterfeit 'Gucci' bag bought for 120,000 won to a luxury repair shop; commenters discuss how convincing counterfeits have become and debate whether cheaper Gucci markdowns make the brand feel less special, tying into the week's price-cut news cycle.

items.title: 구찌 시계 장단점(인증)
items.summary: DC Inside watch-gallery user review weighing pros/cons of a Gucci watch purchase; thread reflects mixed-to-skeptical consumer sentiment on Gucci's non-core accessory categories (perceived build quality vs brand price), typical lower-tier community chatter rather than brand-driven coverage.

items.title: "사자마자 130만원 떨어졌어요"...명품값 인하에 기존 구매자들 '허탈'
items.summary: Covers buyer backlash after Gucci's price cuts (Padlock crystal bag -30% in France; Mercato tote -21.3% in Korea) left recent purchasers feeling cheated with no compensation offered; quotes an online luxury-community member expressing regret. Also notes Gucci quietly raised prices on other items (Marmont mini shoulder bag +9.5%) in late October without notice -- a direct critical-angle consumer-trust story.

items.title: "명품 살 돈이 없어요"...중산층 발길 끊기자 루이비통·구찌에 닥친 위기
items.summary: Reports that shrinking middle-class discretionary spending in Korea and globally is hitting Louis Vuitton and Gucci especially hard, framing both brands' recent price cuts as a defensive reaction to eroding demand rather than a goodwill gesture; cites declining luxury consumer headcount figures also referenced in Hankyung's coverage.

items.title: "명품 살 돈 없어요"...중산층 발길 끊기자 루이비통·구찌에 닥친 위기
items.summary: US-edition syndication of the Herald Economy middle-class luxury-crisis story, extending its reach to the Korean diaspora readership; same critical framing of Gucci and LV's demand erosion.

items.title: "가격 인상은 공식이었는데" 구찌·부쉐론 잇단 인하...명품 '콧대' 꺾였나
items.summary: Analysis piece arguing that the long-standing luxury industry formula of relentless price increases has broken down, citing Gucci and Boucheron's recent cuts as evidence; quotes Prada Group's CEO conceding that 'even discussing price is itself an admission of a mistake' and Burberry's CEO saying consumers are 'exhausted' by excessive luxury pricing.

items.title: 콧대 꺾인 명품...중산층 지갑 닫자 '가격 백기'
items.summary: Financial-wire style piece covering the same luxury price-cut wave with Gucci as lead example; situates the move within Kering's broader financial pressure and contrasts with LVMH's reluctance to follow, noting LVMH's concern that discounting could damage brand trust and perceived exclusivity.

items.title: 古驰包二手能卖多少钱？3个维度揭底回收价+FAQ
items.summary: Resale-market explainer on Chinese secondhand Gucci bag buyback pricing: hot styles (1955 Horsebit, GG Marmont, Dionysus) retain roughly 50-60% of retail, while less popular styles can fall to 10-20%. Signals continued secondary-market softness for Gucci versus Hermes/Chanel resale retention cited in the same piece; same templated FAQ-farm style as other Weibo hits, included as a directional resale-sentiment data point with the caveat that originality/authenticity of individual posts is uncertain.

items.title: Kering plans China store cuts as it rebuilds Gucci's appeal
items.summary: Trade-press report on Kering's plan to rightsize Gucci's China retail network (around 130 net closures through 2030) while simultaneously trying to rebuild desirability under Demna; frames store cuts as a deliberate 'fewer, bigger, better' strategy rather than pure retreat, but acknowledges near-term optics risk in a market already reading Gucci as retreating.

items.title: 뎀나의 첫 구찌 컬렉션, 패션 전문가들의 반응?
items.summary: Roundup of fashion-expert reactions to Demna's debut full Gucci collection 'La Famiglia.' Curator Pamela Golbin praised its clear intent reframing Gucci as a 'family'; critic Barbara Franchin praised storytelling blending irony and retro sexiness. Balances this against earlier market skepticism -- Kering stock fell 10.7% the day Demna's hire was announced, and Barclays analyst Carole Madjo warned his dystopian, underground aesthetic might not resonate with core Gucci clientele.

items.title: ELLE Japan GucciCore event commentary clips
items.summary: ELLE Japan's official short-video account posted commentary clips from attendees at the Nov 16 Gucci Aoyama 'GucciCore' launch event, part of the cross-media Instagram/TikTok push alongside Harper's Bazaar Japan, WWD Japan and Esquire Japan noted in the Madame Figaro report. Included as an SNS-channel data point for the same event; no public like/view counts were visible at time of collection.
